sources.note: equipment plan source (research grade: datasheet); size 480 x 310 x 44 mm (w x d x h); port and control positions are placeholders until measured

Manufacturer page (opened 2026-11-12): 480 mm wide x 44 mm high (1U) x 310 mm deep, about 5 kg; front panel: mic / line / DI inputs with a switchable front combi connector, gain, impedance, pad, phase, EQ, output fader, 7-stage LED meter; rear panel: switchable mic / line inputs, balanced insert send / return, output stage; external 48 Vdc supply. The page does not count the connectors or place each one, so the 7 ports are the knowledge-base proposal set with guessed positions. portsDocumented stays false: the page gives connector types and counts but not which panel carries them; positions are guesses (the shape, not the layout, is what the build checks).
